overview: The Supply Route is the logistical artery of Katta Castellum, ensuring the steady flow of goods, weapons, and resources.
history: Established after the Loyalist schism to secure independent supply lines.
Arcane stabilizers were added to prevent magical ambushes.
Caravan escorts were trained to defend against Seru raiders.
The route became essential for maintaining Loyalist military readiness.
hooks: A caravan goes missing along the route.
Arcane stabilizers pulse irregularly, threatening supply flow.
A Senate directive orders increased escort presence.
A scout reports signs of an ambush ahead.
